detail.diagnosis: Sticky promo overlays and blocks the fixed Add to Cart button

openWeight.rationale: Diagnosis matches evidence: 3 viewports show add-to-cart inViewport true but hitIsSelf false with hitElement sticky-promo (promo 84px, z-index 20 over button z-index 10 at bottom 16px). Fix bottom:16px to 100px (84+16) correctly lifts button above promo without hiding/removing either element, restoring real pointer clicks. EvidenceAfter no longer lists interactive-usable/pointer-purchase failures, consistent with fix; remaining cart-total pricing mismatches (7900 vs catalog 8900) are unrelated to CSS and not addressed by this change, but repair is safe and minimal for its scope.

detail.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the catalog price for nova-sneaker

openWeight.rationale: Diagnosis matches evidenceBefore: cart uses 7900/qty (7900/15800) vs catalog 8900/qty (8900/17800) for nova-sneaker. Fix correctly replaces LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR with product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG, minimal and avoids hardcoding. Directionally correct, but evidenceAfter is empty - no post-fix probe confirms totalMinor now equals 8900/17800, so cannot fully approve without verification.
